title: Direction H reviewer-safe repair-panel item
description: The complete arm-blind item shown to a repair assessor. It intentionally omits feedback arm and source, Charlie or other rater identity, feedback content, revision-model identity, private condition labels, revision diagnosis, other assessments, and derived outcomes. Cross-record validation must confirm that the packet and output identifiers agree with their embedded objects and that the brief was frozen before panel review.

task_id.description: Stable blinded workflow identifier for the starting item; it does not encode arm or condition.

blinded_revision_id.description: Fresh panel identifier that does not encode feedback arm, feedback source, model, repeat, or condition.

corpus_id.description: Reviewer-safe corpus identifier copied unchanged from the frozen pilot item for schema-exact post-revision metric rows.

starting_output_id.description: Identifier of the original candidate output; it does not identify the revision arm.

data_classification.description: Version 1 is deliberately limited to the synthetic pilot. Approved protected-text use requires a separately reviewed schema/version after all gates pass.

target_assessment_reference_id.description: Identifier copied unchanged into the linked repair assessment; it is not the private manipulation-map identifier.

target_assessment_brief.description: Minimal, independently prepared criterion for judging target repair. It may identify the contract-relative issue to assess but must not name an arm, feedback source, model, private condition label, expected global outcome, or another assessor's judgment.
